We're seeing a sudden spike in 500-level errors from the Redwood API starting ~08:55 PST. Impacting our patient-facing flow (approx 18% failure rate over last 10m). We pulled a few snippets from our logs and attached a small file (crimson_error_snippets.txt).

Can you confirm if this is a known degradation or something on your side? This is affecting live users. Please advise next steps and ETA.

Thanks,
Elena

Subject: Redwood update — immediate actions and next steps (Crimson Health)

Elena,

Quick update from the incident bridge (summary for your execs):

What happened
- Starting ~08:55 PST we observed elevated 500 responses for POST /v1/generate in us-west-2 affecting Crimson Health traffic.

What we've done so far
- Stand up bridge (Zoom) and engaged runtime engineering.
- Isolated the affected worker pool and routed traffic to healthy nodes to reduce error rate.
- Identified a subset of nodes that had a kernel selection regression after an autoscaler handoff; we rolled those nodes back to the previous kernel.
- Applied targeted throttling to long-running requests to prevent KV cache exhaustion.

Current status (09:48 PST)
- Error rate reduced from ~18% to ~1.6% for Crimson-specific traffic.
- No data loss reported; requests either succeeded or failed with a clear error code.
- We're monitoring at 10s granularity and will keep the bridge open until stabilized.

Immediate next steps
- Evelyn to validate node fleet health and confirm full rollback of regressed kernels (by 10:30 PST).
- Run targeted replay on a small set of failed requests to validate correctness (Evelyn).
- Marissa will follow up on customer impact and propose credits if SLA thresholds crossed.

Customer-facing commitments
- We will provide a written RCA and postmortem within 72 hours.
- We will share all relevant logs and remediation steps used (attached initial snippets).
- If this meets Crimson's criteria, we are prepared to discuss a goodwill credit for the window of impact.

Attachments: redwood_bridge_notes.docx, crimson_error_snippets.txt

I'll keep you posted and will send another brief at 10:30 PST or sooner if anything changes.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
